VACANCY NOTIFICATION 
Sub: Vacancy Notice for filling up of one post of General Manager (S&T) on deputation basis. 
1. Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. (MRVC Ltd.), a PSU of Govt. of India under 
Ministry of Railways, is a vital project implementation organization working in the 
sensitive Mumbai Suburban area with a very lean organizational structure. 
2. In MRVC Ltd. one post of Geneal Manager (S&T) is required to be filled on deputation 
basis for which applications are invited from experienced, dynamic and motivated officers 
of Indian Railways. 
3. The Vacancy Notice is at Annexure-I. Eligible and interested officers may apply as per the 
application format at Annexure-Il. The duly filled in application should be sent to 
Sr.Manager (HR), Mumbai Railway Vikas Corporation Ltd. by email on 
managetht@mrve.gov.in.  Applicants should simultaneously submit a copy of the 
application to their administrative officer for forwarding the application to MRVC Ltd. 
through Railway Board indicating 'No Objection’, Vigilance/DAR clearance, APAR 
gradings etc. in the format at Annexure-III. 
4. The candidates will be screened by a Selection Committee and their suitability will be 
adjudged keeping in view the job requirements/service particulars/ interaction/ assessment. 
5. On joining the Corporation, the officer will be eligible to draw parent department Pay plus 
Deputation (Duty) Allowance.
